name: Brisbane
tagline: Riverside sunshine, koalas and island day trips
summary: Brisbane is Queensland's easy-going river city, with a man-made beach at South Bank, CityCat ferries and a subtropical climate. Cuddle a koala at Lone Pine, climb the Story Bridge, browse the galleries at GOMA and day-trip to Moreton Island's dunes or the Gold Coast surf.
seasonNote: Autumn to spring (April to September) is warm and dry; summer is hot, humid and stormy.
arrival: Brisbane Airport is 20 minutes from the city on the Airtrain.
gettingAround: Free CityHopper ferries, CityCats and buses with a go card or tap-on bank card.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; cash is rarely needed.
foodTip: Moreton Bay bugs, Queensland mangoes and riverside brunch.
buyTip: Australian-made fashion in James Street and Indigenous art.
